content: Launched my new academic homepage. Apply for PhD programs starting Fall 2027 in environmental economics, energy & climate policy, and urban policy.
Started as Teaching Assistant for Statistics and Program Evaluation (iMEP, Duke Kunshan) under Prof. Xiao Wang.
Completed my master's thesis on land-use and environmental responses to economic shocks.
Joined Prof. Wumeng He's research group at Duke Kunshan as a geospatial data research assistant.
Completed a mixed-methods field study on traditional ecological practice, tourism, and market pressures in mountain tea villages.
Started the Master of Environmental Policy (iMEP) at Duke University · Duke Kunshan University.
